votes_on_bill.question: On Motion to Concur in the Senate Amendment (final bill)

promises.topic: SALT: no vote on a bill without an increase
promises.scope: Stated generally: any bill that does not raise the SALT cap
promises.quote: On a bill that does not raise the SALT Cap Deduction, I am a NO vote.

promises.topic: SALT: promise on any tax bill
promises.source_type: Letter to Senators Booker and Kim
promises.quote: I made a promise to my constituents, colleagues, and party that if a tax bill came before me without an increase in the SALT Deduction, it would not have my support.

promises.topic: SALT: pledge on the reconciliation bill
promises.scope: The House reconciliation bill that became H.R. 1
promises.source_type: Letter to Senators Booker and Kim
promises.quote: As the House started work on its reconciliation bill, I similarly made clear that if it did not include SALT relief, I would vote no.

promises.topic: SALT: $20,000 is the floor, not the ceiling
promises.scope: Said about H.R. 7160, which would have raised the cap to $20,000 for joint filers; a goal for SALT relief generally
promises.quote: Let me be clear, this legislation is the floor, not the ceiling, for the SALT relief we can and must fight to deliver for New Jersey families.

promises.scope: Said about the House-passed version of H.R. 1
promises.quote: On healthcare, we protected Medicaid for every intended beneficiary in New Jersey and across the country and stopped illegal immigrants from stealing taxpayer-funded benefits.

promises.topic: Medicaid supplemental payments to NJ providers
promises.scope: Said about the final H.R. 1 on the day of the vote
promises.quote: I also voted to protect New Jersey’s expansion of certain critical supplemental payments they receive from the federal government—an important financing tool that hospitals, nursing homes, and other health care providers rely on to serve Medicaid patients.

promises.topic: Medicaid: no loss of access to care
promises.scope: General; said after H.R. 1 became law
promises.quote: America’s most vulnerable should never lose access to care because of waste, fraud, or abuse.

I am an independent leader standing up for what is right for New Jersey – working to lower the cost of living, protect healthcare, strengthen our communities, and ensure America is strong at home and around the world.
